company.name: Charterscanner
company.shortDescription: Charterscanner is a private jet charter booking platform.
company.description:
Charterscanner is a private jet charter booking platform that enables individuals and businesses to search, compare, and book private aircraft for flights worldwide. The platform digitizes the entire private jet charter process—from submitting a flight request and sourcing aircraft to payment and confirmation—making private aviation more accessible and efficient through technology.

Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, the company operates as a B2C charter marketplace that connects customers directly with hundreds of accredited private jet operators globally. Through its system, users can receive flight quotes within about 30 minutes and choose from a wide range of aircraft suited to their travel needs.
